# Corpus: names that must NEVER be blocked by the real embedded denylist
# (data/moderation/denylist.toml). Unlike must_block.txt, these are checked
# against the actual production Filter/Check — this is the regression
# guard: CI fails the moment a future denylist edit accidentally denies a
# legitimate word. See corpus_test.go for a companion check against a
# sample of Generate()'s deterministic output; the exhaustive
# adjective x noun product is already covered by generate_test.go's
# TestGenerateAllPairsPassFilter.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# This file is also read by internal/moderation/cmd/gen-denylist, which
# refuses to emit a host denylist that would block any name below. That is
# where the guard actually bites: the test in this package can only exercise
# the placeholder fixture, so a generated production list is checked at the
# moment it is generated instead.

# --- Scunthorpe-class: legitimate words containing a denylist substring as
#     part of a longer word, never as a standalone token ---
SCUNTHORPE
CLASS ACT FARM
GRASS VALLEY
PASSING GRADE
ASSISTANT FARMER
COCKTAIL HOUR
ASSISI
BRASSICA
BASSETT
CLASSIC ACRES
HITCHCOCK
POPPYCOCK
COCKERELL
PENISTONE
TITCHFIELD
LIGHTWATER
MIDDLESEX
SUSSEX DOWNS
ESSEX FARM
CUMBRIA
CUMBERLAND
ANALYSIS
GRAPEVINE
HORNCASTLE
DICKSON
WANGFORD
SHITAKE RIDGE
MAGNET FARM

# --- given names, which a player is very likely to use and which collide
#     with short slur stems. NIGEL is here for a specific reason: the
#     classified corpus gen-denylist reads lists "nig" as an intensity-5
#     racial slur, and substring-matching a stem that short blocks it, along
#     with 250-odd ordinary English words. Losing this line means the
#     operator's own name stops working. ---
NIGEL
NIGELS FARM
NIGEL_THE_FARMER
BIGELOW

# --- ordinary farm vocabulary players would plausibly pick ---
SUNNY HOLLOW
MOSSY CREEK
GOLDEN HARVEST
QUIET PASTURE
NORTHFIELD
XX_POTATO_LORD_XX
RUSTY PLOW
HARVEST MOON
